properties.description: Every served skill is named by at least one shipped slash command, and a skill that loses its command turns the lint red naming the skill (tools/skill_lint.py, `== commands ==`). The counterweight to `every command names a skill that exists`, which had guarded only the opposite direction since 2026-07-28 — a command rotting into a dangling reference — while a skill nobody fronted was checked by nothing and nothing pinned the count. Coverage is NAMED BY a command, not SAME NAME AS one, so the short aliases (/gaps → detect-and-ask, /where → where-am-i) still count.
